summary: Unidentified adult male swimming with his dog in the Colorado River near the Blue Heron Boat ramp, Grand Junction, was later seen floating face down; witnesses reported the 911 call ~11:50 a.m. Tuesday; the Grand Junction Fire Department reached the man and pulled him from the water but life-saving measures were unsuccessful; the dog was found and is safe; apparent drowning, under investigation by the Mesa County Sheriff's Office and coroner
location: Colorado River near the Blue Heron Boat ramp, Grand Junction
responding_agency: Grand Junction Fire Department; Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Coroner's Office
